_about: The canon-lock act (List 21, #197): the registry procedure by which a considered species (id: null, baseStats null — the design lane's draft discipline, verified in mochichao-design/COVERAGE-AND-ROADMAP.md and world-systems/evolution-edges.wave1.json) becomes a locked canon species. OWNER RULING (Jamar, 2026-10-27): numbers are the NEXT roster numbers, allocated in LOCK ORDER, filling the empty roster; regional order is a VIEW (#198), never the number. Two states only — a provisional number is a number, and numbers before lock are the failure this discipline exists to prevent.
count_base: canon core roster = 47 (the line species.json's repair represents — roster raw runs 001-046 then 331 for Mythar; species.json repairs Mythar to 047; the dex registry keeps 331 and adds 147/148 for Dorowani/Gabu, who have no core id). Counting forward from 47 does NOT reconcile the dex-layer discrepancies; that reconciliation is a separate OPEN owner decision (GAP-AUDIT Conflicts 1-2).
evolution_join: A locked species' evolution edges (#8) may gain trigger values at lock — numbers enter the world at the lock act and nowhere else (#199). Unlocked species keep trigger: null however complete their prose.

lock_act_writes.approval_provenance: owner design verdict, verbatim, + design file hashes (the art manifest pattern already in force for the A1/A2 approvals)
lock_act_writes.lock_order: the act's position in the lock sequence, recorded beside the number (the number is the address; the order is the audit trail)
lock_act_writes.roster_number: next unfilled number in the canon sequence at the moment of the act — sequential fill, no gaps chosen, no number ever reused
lock_act_writes.stat_block_seat: stat numbers set at the SAME act by the data lane — this package defines the seat and the simultaneity, never the values

open_register: the Gen 1 numbering reconciliation entire (331 vs 047; Dorowani/Gabu core ids) — owner's, untouched by the lock
every future species' number (allocated at its lock, unknowable before)
stat values at each lock (data-lane work)
whether a lock can ever be revised (proposed: numbers are permanent; revision would be an owner ruling, not a procedure in this package)
register_note: Lock order and regional order coincide in the first register ONLY because the owner approved the lines in order. The allocation rule is lock order; a species approved out of regional order still takes the next roster number.
two_axes_law: Locking is not discovering. Roster membership is GLOBAL (changed only by a lock act); Mochiioteca visibility is PER-RANGER (discovery state, #198 / List 1 item 3). A lock writes no Ranger's facts — for any given Ranger it adds exactly one silhouette (#198).
